data.one_liner: A draggable and scrollable sheet widget that snaps to a list of extents.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SlidingSheet widget and BottomSheetDialog that can be dragged, scrolled in a single gesture, and snapped to custom extents. It supports headers, footers, parallax effects, and manual control via a SheetController.
use_when: You need a bottom sheet that supports complex snapping behaviors and single-gesture dragging and scrolling.
You want to display a persistent sliding panel above your app body.
avoid_when: You only need standard native Material bottom sheets without custom snapping or single-gesture scroll integration.
Your content has infinite or unbounded height without handling shrinkWrap and physics.
strengths: Can be used either as a permanent widget in the tree or as a dialog via bottom sheet functions.
Supports custom snapping positions relative to available space, sheet height, or pixel offset.
Includes built-in header and footer support that remain fixed while content scrolls.
weaknesses: Children like ListView or Column require specific height configurations (e.g., shrinkWrap) to prevent unbounded height errors.
